anti_pattern_scope: Anti-patterns and negative-element phrases match document-wide by default. Controls whose remaining patterns are generic qualifiers declare `test.anti_pattern_anchors`; a hit counts only when an anchor term appears in the same or the preceding sentence (adapter/payload.py: anchored). Confining matches to retrieval windows was tried and rejected: a deficient policy that avoids the statutory wording produces no windows, so its wrong language was lost (DEFICIENT fell to ABSENT on 9 controls in the city-deficient-deposits fixture).
